text:
ara: Heads up — spike of Pending tiny-gang pods in eu-west1c. Lots of 1-GPU pods stuck Pending even though some nodes report idle GPUs. Scheduler keeps saying 'no suitable nodes'. Anyone seeing this?

sam: Seeing it too. Scheduler traces show slot fragmentation + nodeFence churn. Snippet: ```
E scheduler.go: failed to bind pod: no matching resources: [gpu:1] nodeAffinity conflicts, taint mismatch
```
Also some net probes to eu-west1c rack3 timed out.

morgan: Probably affinity + leftover taints from maintenance. Warmpool autoscaler flipped sizes last night and some nodes stayed tainted. Quick mitigation: untaint a couple of nodes to unblock the queue.

jin: @morgan yep — maintenance job cordoned several nodes earlier. Found orphan taint `gpu.card/isolated:NoSchedule` on 4 nodes. Also one rack shows nvlink errors: `kernel: nvlink recovery failed` in dmesg.

deploy-bot: Autoscaler: scaled up warmpool-eu-west1c by 2 nodes at 12:02:13 — reason: pending pods > threshold.

ara: Proposed plan: 1) remove taint on 2 nodes to relieve backlog, 2) move/evict long-waiting tiny-gang pods to fallback pool if needed, 3) run a descheduler canary to coalesce tiny pods. Obj: reduce pending and avoid large-scale evictions.

sam: SGTM. Quick commands: `kubectl taint nodes <node> gpu.card/isolated-` to remove. For evictions maybe avoid force delete; prefer graceful move. Example: label fallback and shift affinity.

morgan: Don't force-delete user jobs. I'll untaint and watch. Running: ```
for n in eu-west1c-node12 eu-west1c-node15; do kubectl taint nodes $n gpu.card/isolated-; done
```

jin: Also saw conntrack exhaustion on top-of-rack causing transient NotReady nodes — that makes scheduler think capacity is less than it is. Ops recommends bumping `net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max`.

ara: Action owners: @morgan remove taints on node12 & 15, @jin coordinate net team to bump conntrack on rack3, @sam monitor pending queue and prepare descheduler canary if backlog doesn't drop in 10m. I'll watch metrics.

morgan: Taints removed. Pod scheduling log now shows placements being assigned.

sam: Pending count dropped 132 -> 18 in ~90s. A few still failing with `AffinityMismatch` complaining about preferred zone `eu-west1c-a` skew.

jin: Net team bumped conntrack to 262144 on rack3: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144`. No NotReady events for 2m. :tada:

morgan: Follow-up note: warmpool mix (many p3.2xlarge / many single-slot gaps) makes fragmentation worse for tiny-gangs. Suggest scheduler preference to pack tiny-gangs onto larger-instance families or prefer co-located allocation. Will be a cost vs fragmentation tradeoff.

ara: Agreed — add a short RFC/PR to scheduler prefs to prefer co-location for tiny-gang workloads and a metric to measure slot utilization. @sam add to backlog and run a cost sim.

deploy-bot: Alert: evictions triggered during remediation — 12 pods evicted from waiting-queue at 12:05:40.

sam: Systems look stable now. I'll follow up with cost/frac report and a canary plan for a compacting policy.

ara: Thanks team. Closing this thread unless new signals. :white_check_mark:
